summary: Comprehensive testing of Enhanced Website Projects page v3 with Operations Head features. Backend: 22/22 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 13 features working correctly including All Projects view, cross-project tasks panel, Page Detail view with Screenshots/Subtasks/Sections, and Section sidebar with 4 phase tabs and client feedback.
critical_code_review_comments: WebsiteProjectsPage.js at 1200 lines is well-structured with 3 clear views (all-projects, project-detail, page-detail)
All APIs properly exclude MongoDB _id field
Proper use of data-testid attributes for testability
Phase cards correctly show Status, Assignee, Due Date for each phase (Wireframe, UI, Content, Dev)
Good use of fixed positioning for Section sidebar (w-96, z-50)
Cross-project tasks panel shows correctly when due date filter is applied
seed_data_creation: Test sections, subtasks, and feedback created via Playwright testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Enhanced Website Projects page v3 fully tested. All 13 requested features verified: 1) All Projects view with Dev%, Overall%, Developer, Onboarding, Deadline, Pages columns, 2) Due date filter triggers cross-project tasks panel, 3) Developer filter works, 4) Click project opens Project Detail, 5) Project Detail shows phase stats and pages table, 6) Click page opens Page Detail (Google Docs-like), 7) Page Detail shows 4 phase cards with Status/Assignee/Due Date, 8) Screenshots section with paste URL, 9) Tasks/Notes section with auto-generated date, 10) Sections section with add functionality, 11) Click section opens Phase sidebar with 4 tabs, 12) Each phase tab has Status/Assignee/Due Date/URL, 13) Client feedback with add/resolve. NO MOCKED APIs.
